# Nagarajan Thathasamy — Security Engineer

> Security engineer in Chennai, India with 3+ years in SOC operations, detection engineering, incident response and digital forensics (DFIR). Security Engineer (SecOps L2/L3) at Zoho Corporation since Aug 2025; SOC Analyst at Intellect Design Arena from Jun 2023 to Aug 2025. Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200).

Key facts:

- Protects a hybrid estate of 40,000+ endpoints across AWS, Azure and on-prem.
- EDR / XDR: CrowdStrike Falcon administration (sensor health, policies, host groups, device/USB control, custom IOAs), Cynet XDR, Trend Micro Apex One.
- SIEM: CrowdStrike Falcon LogScale (NG-SIEM), ManageEngine Log360, IBM QRadar, FortiSIEM, Microsoft Sentinel. Onboards log sources, writes parsers, correlation and detection rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain.
- AI security: CrowdStrike Falcon AIDR policies that detect sensitive-data leakage and prompt injection in AI tools.
- Also: SpyCloud credential-leak monitoring, Forcepoint DLP, Magnet AXIOM and Cellebrite forensics, Nessus and Qualys vulnerability management, Python automation.
- Built LogSec (AI-assisted, case-based SIEM that searches 1.6M+ events per file in under a second with a local LLM), GIT Recon (source-code and dark-web secret-exposure scanner, 7,000+ findings) and Vuln-MS (vulnerability management platform, 150+ scans a month).
